summary: Phase S1 survives all seven requested adversarial counterexamples: export-target, dependency, provider/environment, ESM-specifier, provenance inventory/tree, behavior-equivalence, and dependency-cycle mutations were detected while the accepted workspace remained unchanged.
nonblocking_findings: S1-ADVERSARIAL-001 [low]: Export, bare-dependency, forbidden-import/environment, and relative-ESM attacks are permanent focused-contract guards. Inventory/tree, normalized behavior-equivalence, and cycle attacks were verified through the requested static acceptance probe; promote that probe into a committed compatibility/governance test during Phase S4 so it runs automatically for every future extraction or release.
evidence: Accepted baseline 60397049 passes the focused contract 10/10.
Missing export artifact attack: changing a conditional export to ./dist/does-not-exist.js is rejected by the runtime target existence/load guard.

Undeclared dependency attack: removing zod from an in-memory srs-engine manifest is rejected because objective-policy.ts imports zod and the inverse dependency guard requires dependencies or peerDependencies.
Forbidden provider/app/environment attack: a React import plus process.env access is rejected by the provider-neutral and environment-access guards.
Non-.js relative specifier attack: an extensionless relative re-export is rejected by the ESM specifier guard.

Source tree/file-count attack: the static provenance probe validated all four frozen tree IDs and 199 source/destination tracked paths, then detected in-memory sourceFileCount and sourceTree corruption.

Unexplained behavior-bearing deviation attack: the normalized comparison first proved 183/183 non-configuration files equal with zero differences, then detected an injected unapproved exported constant.

Dependency-cycle attack: the graph probe first proved the four-package production graph acyclic, then detected an injected practice-core to srs-engine edge completing the existing srs-engine to practice-core cycle.

The adversarial harness reported allDetected=true for seven attacks, currentInventoryOk=true, normalizedFilesCompared=183, normalizedDifferences=0, currentDependencyCycle=false, and no current srs-engine dependency violations.
Post-attack git status and diff checks show no changes to the four packages, focused contract, or provenance artifact.
commands: TZ=UTC pnpm exec vitest run packages/__tests__/mastery-engine-import-contract.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=dot (accepted baseline pass: 10/10)
In-memory Node/TypeScript-AST adversarial harness for seven counterexamples plus frozen git-tree/content comparison (pass: allDetected=true)
git status --short and git diff --check scoped to the focused contract, four packages, and provenance (pass: no adversarial mutations remain)
